subject: The lender-ready PDF (and the rest of Pro)
preheader: PDF export, BRRRR, 10-year projections, deal compare.
headline: You're underwriting deals — here's what Pro adds when one gets serious.
body: You've been running deals on TrueCap — nice. When a deal gets real, Pro is what turns the analysis into something you can act on and share.

It adds the one-click lender-ready PDF, the BRRRR and fix-and-flip analyzers, 10-year projections, tax strategy and exit scenarios, the sensitivity grid and max-offer solver, saved deals and side-by-side compare, and your Deal Score.
Pro is $20/mo, month-to-month, cancel anytime — and your saved deals never leave your account. Most people run free for a while, then upgrade the first time a deal is worth a lender packet.
